rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Бульк! Камень утонул!
rows.text: Splash! The stone sank!
rows.heard: Splash the stone sink.

rows.name: Пик
rows.ru: Смотрите, а вот лодка! Большая — и не тонет!
rows.text: Look, here's a boat! It's big, and it doesn't sink!
rows.heard: Look, here's a boat. It's big and it doesn't sink.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Нечестно! Маленький камень тонет, а большая лодка плавает!
rows.text: No fair! A little stone sinks, but a big boat floats!
rows.heard: No fair, a little stone sinks but a big boat floats.

rows.name: Топа
rows.ru: Почему так?
rows.text: But why?
rows.heard: But why?

rows.name: Филя
rows.ru: Рон, а зонтик зачем?
rows.text: Why the umbrella, Ron?
rows.heard: Why the umbrella run?

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Мы раскрываем секрет лодки. Вдруг секрет окажется мокрым!
rows.text: We're uncovering the boat's secret. What if the secret is wet!
rows.heard: We're uncovering the boat secret. What if the secret is wet?

rows.name: Филя
rows.ru: Даже кепку приготовился защищать?
rows.text: You're even ready to protect your cap?
rows.heard: You're even ready to protect your cap.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Конечно. Она плавать не умеет.
rows.text: Of course. It can't swim.
rows.heard: Of course, it can't swim.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Может, лодка училась плавать? А камень прогуливал!
rows.text: Maybe the boat learned to swim? And the stone skipped class!
rows.heard: Maybe the boat learned to swim and the stone skipped class.

rows.name: Барсик
rows.ru: Тогда кто учил лодку?
rows.text: Then who taught the boat?
rows.heard: then who taught the boat?

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Очень терпеливая рыба?
rows.text: A very patient fish?
rows.heard: A very patient fish.

rows.name: Пик
rows.ru: Давайте найдём объяснение, которое можно проверить.
rows.text: Let's find an explanation we can test.
rows.heard: Let's find an explanation we can test.

rows.name: Барсик
rows.ru: Вот точно такой же камень, как утонул.
rows.text: Here's a stone just like the one that sank.
rows.heard: Here's a stone, just like the one that sank.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Здравствуйте. Сегодня вопросов будет больше.
rows.text: Hello. Today we have more questions.
rows.heard: Hello, today we have more questions.

rows.name: Филя
rows.ru: Он маленький. Но тяжёлый для своего размера.
rows.text: It's small. But it's heavy for its size.
rows.heard: It's small, but it's heavy for its size.

rows.name: Топа
rows.ru: А лодка большая. И ещё людей возит.
rows.text: And the boat is big. It even carries people.
rows.heard: and the boat is big, it even carries people.

rows.name: Пик
rows.ru: Значит, одного размера для ответа мало.
rows.text: So size alone isn't enough.
rows.heard: Show size alone isn't enough.

rows.name: Барсик
rows.ru: Из чего делают лодки?
rows.text: What are boats made of?
rows.heard: What are boats made of?

rows.name: Топа
rows.ru: Из дерева!
rows.text: From wood!
rows.heard: from wood.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Разгадали! Дерево плавает.
rows.text: Solved it! Wood floats.
rows.heard: Solved it, wood floats.

rows.name: Пик
rows.ru: Но бывают и металлические корабли.
rows.text: But there are metal ships too.
rows.heard: But there are metal ships too.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Металлические? Как ложка?
rows.text: Metal? Like a spoon?
rows.heard: Metal like a spoon.

rows.name: Пик
rows.ru: Да. Обычная металлическая ложка тонет. А корабль может плавать.
rows.text: Yes. A metal spoon sinks. But a ship can float.
rows.heard: Yes, a metal spoon sinks, but a ship can float.

rows.name: Филя
rows.ru: Тогда надо искать другую подсказку.
rows.text: Then we need another clue.
rows.heard: Then we need another clue.

rows.name: Рассказчик
rows.ru: Друзья отправились на кухню сравнить знакомые предметы.
rows.text: The friends went to the kitchen to compare familiar things.
rows.heard: The friends went to the kitchen to compare familiar things.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Чем не корабль? Даже длинный хвост есть!
rows.text: It's a ship! It even has a long tail!
rows.heard: It's a ship. It even has a long tail.

rows.name: Топа
rows.ru: А это похоже на круглую лодку.
rows.text: And this looks like a round boat.
rows.heard: And this looks like a round boat.

rows.name: Филя
rows.ru: У неё есть дно и стенки. А внутри свободное место!
rows.text: It has a bottom and sides. And inside there's empty space!
rows.heard: It has a bottom and sides, and inside there's empty space.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: И обед далеко искать не надо.
rows.text: And lunch is never far away!
rows.heard: And lunch is never far away.

rows.name: Топа
rows.ru: Если туда налить суп, свободного места станет меньше.
rows.text: If you pour soup in, there's less empty space.
rows.heard: If you pour soup in, there's less empty space.

rows.name: Пик
rows.ru: Филя заметил важное отличие. Корабль внутри тоже не сплошной.
rows.text: Filya noticed something important. A ship isn't solid inside either.
rows.heard: Philia noticed something important. A ship isn't solid inside either.

rows.name: Барсик
rows.ru: Но почему это помогает ему плавать?
rows.text: But why does that help it float?
rows.heard: But why does that help it float?

rows.name: Филя
rows.ru: Пока не знаю.
rows.text: I don't know yet.
rows.heard: I don't know yet.

rows.name: Пик
rows.ru: У меня есть книга о кораблях. Поищем ответ.
rows.text: I have a book about ships. Let's find the answer.
rows.heard: I have a book about ships. Let's find the answer.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Хорошо. Кастрюля всё равно ничего не рассказывает.
rows.text: Okay. The pot isn't telling us anything anyway.
rows.heard: Okay, the pod isn't telling us anything anyway.

rows.name: Филя
rows.ru: Вода выталкивает погружённые в неё предметы вверх
rows.text: Water pushes things in it upward.
rows.heard: Water pushes things in upward.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Даже камень?
rows.text: Even a stone?
rows.heard: Even a stone.

rows.name: Пик
rows.ru: Даже камень. Но удержать его не может.
rows.text: Even a stone. But it can't hold it up.
rows.heard: Even a stone, but it can't hold it up.

rows.name: Барсик
rows.ru: Корпус корабля делают полым. Внутри остаётся место для воздуха
rows.text: A ship's body is made hollow. Inside there's room for air.
rows.heard: A ship's body is made hollow. Inside, there's room for air.

rows.name: Топа
rows.ru: Значит, большой корабль не набит металлом целиком!
rows.text: So a big ship isn't all full of metal!
rows.heard: So a big ship isn't all full of metal.

rows.name: Пик
rows.ru: Да. Он занимает много места в воде и раздвигает её.
rows.text: Yes. It takes up a lot of room in the water and pushes it aside.
rows.heard: Yes, it takes up a lot of room in the water and pushes it aside.

rows.name: Барсик
rows.ru: А вода толкает корабль вверх.
rows.text: And the water pushes the ship up.
rows.heard: and the water pushes the ship up.

rows.name: Филя
rows.ru: И удерживает весь его вес?
rows.text: And holds up all its weight?
rows.heard: and holds up all its weight.

rows.name: Барсик
rows.ru: Верно. Если корабль не слишком тяжёлый для своего размера.
rows.text: Right. If the ship isn't too heavy for its size.
rows.heard: right if the ship isn't too heavy for its size.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Теперь понятно, зачем ему столько места внутри!
rows.text: Now I get why it needs so much room inside!
rows.heard: Now I get why it needs so much room inside.

rows.name: Топа
rows.ru: Тогда в корабль можно складывать сколько угодно вещей?
rows.text: Then can we put as many things on a ship as we want?
rows.heard: Then can we put as many things on a ship as we want?

rows.name: Филя
rows.ru: Каждая вещь добавляет вес.
rows.text: Every thing adds weight.
rows.heard: Everything adds weight.

rows.name: Пик
rows.ru: Верно. Если перегрузить корабль, он может утонуть.
rows.text: Right. If you overload a ship, it can sink.
rows.heard: Right! If you overload a ship, it can sink!

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Даже если вещи очень нужные?
rows.text: Even if the things are really important?
rows.heard: Even if the things are really important.

rows.name: Барсик
rows.ru: Даже тогда.
rows.text: Even then.
rows.heard: Even then.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Придётся оставить коллекцию камней дома.
rows.text: I'll have to leave my rock collection at home.
rows.heard: I'll have to leave my rock collection at home.

rows.name: Топа
rows.ru: А если внутрь попадёт много воды?
rows.text: And what if lots of water gets inside?
rows.heard: And what if lots of water gets inside?

rows.name: Филя
rows.ru: Корабль тоже станет тяжелее!
rows.text: The ship will get heavier too!
rows.heard: The ship will get heavier too.

rows.name: Пик
rows.ru: Поэтому важно, чтобы корпус был целым.
rows.text: That's why the ship must have no holes.
rows.heard: That's why the ship must have no holes.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Снаружи вода помогает. А внутри может мешать.
rows.text: Outside, water helps. But inside, it's trouble.
rows.heard: Outside water helps, but inside it's trouble.

rows.name: Филя
rows.ru: Кажется, я придумал, как проверить, что мы поняли.
rows.text: I think I know how to check what we've learned.
rows.heard: I think I know how to check what we've learned.

rows.name: Топа
rows.ru: Проведёшь игру?
rows.text: Will you lead a game?
rows.heard: Well, you let a game.

rows.name: Филя
rows.ru: Попробую.
rows.text: I'll try.
rows.heard: I'll try.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: У нас будет капитан!
rows.text: We'll have a captain!
rows.heard: We'll have a captain.

rows.name: Топа
rows.ru: Капитан Мишка готов слушать.
rows.text: Captain Teddy is ready to listen.
rows.heard: Captain Teddy is ready to listen.

rows.name: Филя
rows.ru: Я буду говорить. Если согласны — кивните. Если нет — покачайте головой.
rows.text: I'll say something. If you agree, nod. If not, shake your head.
rows.heard: I'll say something if you agree, nod. If not, shake your head.

rows.name: Барсик
rows.ru: Начинай!
rows.text: Go ahead!
rows.heard: Go ahead.

rows.name: Филя
rows.ru: Маленький предмет обязательно плавает.
rows.text: A small thing always floats.
rows.heard: A small thing always floats.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Нет. Маленький камень может утонуть.
rows.text: No. A little stone can sink.
rows.heard: No, a little stone can sink.

rows.name: Топа
rows.ru: Капитан согласен!
rows.text: The captain agrees!
rows.heard: The captain agrees.

rows.name: Филя
rows.ru: Вода толкает вверх только деревянные предметы.
rows.text: Water pushes up only wooden things.
rows.heard: Water pushes up only wooden things.

rows.name: Пик
rows.ru: Нет. Металлические тоже.
rows.text: No. Metal ones too.
rows.heard: No, metal ones too.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Просто ложку удержать не получается.
rows.text: It just can't hold up a spoon.
rows.heard: It just can't hold up a spoon.

rows.name: Филя
rows.ru: Правильно! А теперь самый хитрый вопрос.
rows.text: Right! And now the trickiest question.
rows.heard: Right, and now the trickiest question.

rows.name: Филя
rows.ru: Если в лодке есть воздух, она никогда не утонет.
rows.text: If a boat has air inside, it will never sink.
rows.heard: If a boat has air inside, it will never sink.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Есть воздух — можно плыть!
rows.text: There's air, so it can float!
rows.heard: There's air so it can float.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Стойте. Я что-то забыл.
rows.text: Wait. I forgot something.
rows.heard: Wait, I forgot something.

rows.name: Филя
rows.ru: А если положить туда всю твою коллекцию камней?
rows.text: What if we put your whole rock collection in it?
rows.heard: What if we put your whole rock collection in it?

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Она станет слишком тяжёлой!
rows.text: It'll be too heavy!
rows.heard: It'll be too heavy.

rows.name: Филя
rows.ru: Да. Лодку поддерживает вода. Но слишком тяжёлую лодку она не удержит.
rows.text: Yes. The water holds the boat up. But it can't hold up a boat that's too heavy.
rows.heard: Yes, the water holds the boat up, but it can't hold up a boat that's too heavy.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Тогда меняю ответ. Лодку нельзя перегружать.
rows.text: Then I'll change my answer. Don't overload a boat.
rows.heard: Then I'll change my answer, don't overload a boat.

rows.name: Топа
rows.ru: Капитан Мишка доволен!
rows.text: Captain Teddy is happy!
rows.heard: Captain Teddy is happy.

rows.name: Барсик
rows.ru: Филя, ты придумал хороший вопрос.
rows.text: Filya, that was a good question.
rows.heard: Philia, that was a good question.

rows.name: Филя
rows.ru: Я боялся запутаться.
rows.text: I was afraid I'd get mixed up.
rows.heard: I was afraid I'd get mixed up.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: А помог разобраться мне!
rows.text: But you helped me figure it out!
rows.heard: But you helped me figure it out.

rows.name: Топа
rows.ru: Держи. Капитан хочет тебя поблагодарить.
rows.text: Here. The captain wants to thank you.
rows.heard: Here, the captain wants to thank you.

rows.name: Филя
rows.ru: Спасибо за службу, капитан!
rows.text: Thank you for your service, captain!
rows.heard: Thank you for your service, Captain.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Теперь ему положен отпуск. На сухой подушке!
rows.text: Now he gets a vacation. On a dry pillow!
rows.heard: Now he gets a vacation on a dry pillow.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Секрет раскрыли. И даже кепку не намочили!
rows.text: Secret solved. And my cap didn't even get wet!
rows.heard: Secret solved, and my cap didn't even get wet.

rows.name: Барсик
rows.ru: А дома вас ждёт ещё одна загадка.
rows.text: And at home, another riddle is waiting.
rows.heard: And at home, another riddle is waiting.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Надеюсь, тоже сухая!
rows.text: I hope it's dry too!
rows.heard: I hope it's dry too.

rows.name: Рассказчик
rows.ru: Дома Барсик приготовил новую загадку.
rows.text: At home, Barsik prepared a new riddle.
rows.heard: At home, Barsick prepared a new riddle.

rows.name: Барсик
rows.ru: Кто повторяет твои движения, но живёт в стекле?
rows.text: Who copies your moves but lives in glass?
rows.heard: who copies your moves but lives in glass.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Тень? Мы с ней уже знакомы!
rows.text: A shadow? We've already met!
rows.heard: A shadow we've already met.

rows.name: Филя
rows.ru: Тень в стекле не живёт.
rows.text: Shadows don't live in glass.
rows.heard: Shadows don't live in glass.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: О, это я!
rows.text: Oh, it's me!
rows.heard: Oh, it's me.

rows.name: Пик
rows.ru: Узнал?
rows.text: Know him?
rows.heard: I know him.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Да. Но почему отражение всё за мной повторяет?
rows.text: Yes. But why does my reflection copy everything I do?
rows.heard: Yes, but why does my reflection copy everything I do?

rows.name: Топа
rows.ru: Даже когда ты ничего не просишь?
rows.text: Even when you don't ask it to?
rows.heard: even when you don't ask it to.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Особенно тогда!
rows.text: Especially then!
rows.heard: Especially then.

rows.name: Барсик
rows.ru: Завтра раскроем секрет зеркальца.
rows.text: Tomorrow we'll solve the mirror's secret.
rows.heard: Tomorrow we'll solve the mirror's secret.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Тогда завтра причешусь. Нас там всё-таки двое!
rows.text: Then I'll comb my hair tomorrow. There are two of us in there!
rows.heard: Then I'll comb my hair tomorrow. There are two of us in there.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Понравился мультик? Попроси маму или папу подписаться на канал. До встречи в новой серии!
rows.text: Did you like the cartoon? Ask your mom or dad to subscribe to the channel. See you in the next episode!
rows.heard: Did you like the cartoon? Ask your mom or dad to subscribe to the channel. See you in the next episode!
